evaluation.results_summary: The model is a fine-tuned version of Qwen/Qwen2-72B-Instruct, intended to improve natural language understanding and generation. The developer aimed for a versatile model that performs well across many benchmarks and real-world applications. Its post-training process follows the same approach as calme-2.1-qwen2-72b, with different parameters and a longer training period.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports no training/evaluation details beyond naming the fine-tuning dataset and following a prior recipe, so inner workings and evaluation process are undocumented.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card names only the fine-tuning dataset (truthy-dpo-v0.1-axolotl) and gives no collection, curation, or composition details.

possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card does not describe the origin, ownership, or transformations of the truthy-dpo-v0.1-axolotl data, so provenance is not established.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: The card says the model is versatile and aimed at many real-world applications but does not define intended use or misuse boundaries.
